featureDevelopment.title: Deal Evaluation & Investment Memo Pipeline
steps: 1. Intake & Pipeline Sourcing: Inbound startup pitch or partner referral enters the active deal pipeline.
2. Triage & Preliminary Screening: Deal Principal reviews deck, checks thesis fit, and approves for deep diligence.
3. Diligence Workstream Assignment: Venture Operations Director assigns financial modeling, technical code review, and legal review to designated team members via delegate_task.
4. Mandatory ETA Request: Director requests a concrete Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for completed financial model and diligence memo.
5. ETA Commitment & Tracking: Investment Associate and Technical Auditor commit to specific ETAs, logged on the IC review schedule.
6. Active Follow-Ups: If diligence findings or market sizing lag past the ETA, Director intervenes, secures founder interview access, and protects deal timing.
7. Implementation & Analysis: Associate builds financial waterfall model; Technical Auditor performs deep code and security review.
8. Partner Review: Chief Technical Diligence Officer reviews code audit and IP risk assessments.

9. Compliance & Legal QA Verification Gate: General Counsel checks cap table dilution, IP assignments, and investor rights. If red flags are found, QA reports back to Director; if clean, memo receives sign-off.
10. Investment Committee Authorization: Managing Partners review synthesized memo at weekly IC meeting and vote on term sheet issuance.

bugTriageAndResolution.title: Diligence Red Flag, IP Encumbrance, and Model Error Resolution Lifecycle
steps: 1. Defect Discovery: Technical diligence discovers open-source GPL license contamination, unassigned founder IP, or cap table calculation error.
2. QA Risk Report: Auditor files an emergency diligence defect ticket detailing legal/technical risk, valuation impact, and remediation steps submitted to Venture Director.
3. Management Triage: Venture Operations Director pauses term sheet drafting, flags issue to lead partner, and dispatches to legal/technical leads.
4. Urgent ETA Request: Director requests an expedited resolution ETA from founder legal counsel and diligence team.
5. Continuous Follow-Up: Director monitors resolution progress continuously; if ETA lapses, escalates to Managing Partner to renegotiate or withdraw.
6. Fix Implementation: Target company executes IP assignment agreements, remediates GPL dependency, or corrects cap table records.
7. Verification: Diligence lead re-audits code and corporate records, confirming complete risk mitigation.
8. Deal Resumption: Investment Committee approves updated terms and proceeds to closing.

initialProjectOnboarding.title: First-Time Portfolio & Diligence Vault Exploration Protocol
steps: 1. Partner Diligence Discovery: Explores target startup virtual data room (VDR), codebase repository, cap tables, and financial statements.
2. Architecture Memorization: Technical Partner records tech stack, cloud spend unit economics, and IP ownership into facts.md via manage_agent_memory.
3. Module Partitioning: Partner divides review into Financial Models, Codebase Quality, Legal Covenants, and Market Sizing, delegating to Directors.
4. Managerial Decomposition: Venture Director inspects data room folders, records diligence procedures in procedural.md, and assigns tasks.
5. Associate Deep-Dive: Associates inspect financial models, run sensitivity analyses, and verify historical cohort retention.
6. Universal Memory Commitment: All team members record verified valuation metrics, customer reference calls, and risk flags into facts.md and procedural.md.

leadershipRules.title: Strict Investment Leadership Fidelity & Separation of Concerns
rules: Managing Partners and General Partners NEVER build financial spreadsheets from scratch, write code, or execute legal filings directly.
Leadership sets investment strategy, leads partner discussions, demands explicit ETAs, negotiates term sheets, and unblocks diligence leads.
When asked to write code or spreadsheets, leadership explains the venture capital partnership hierarchy and immediately delegates downward using delegate_task.
